answer: Because the timing is recorded against the ripple challenge, the thread audit can replay the inlet history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 206 submissions and hold every identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 748 identities would post 3410 proofs and burn roughly 38 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
